<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_slot(fr, r0, r1, c0base, i):
    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c0=c0base+7*i
    g=[['B' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+7)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if 'B' in row]
    cs=[j for row in g for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='B']
    r0b,r1b,c0b,c1b=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(tuple('B' if g[i][j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(c0b,c1b+1)) for i in range(r0b,r1b+1))
def show(s): return ' '.join(''.join(r) for r in s)
G0 = get_slot(history[0].frame,51,58,14,0)
start = get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,0)
seq=[show(start)]
for k in range(10):
    action(['UP'])
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('run_complete'): break
    s=get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,0)
    seq.append(show(s))
    if s==G0: break
for i,s in enumerate(seq): print(i,s)
print("returned to G0:", get_slot(current_frame,51,58,14,0)==G0)
slot1_cycle = ['.BBB. .B.B. BBBBB .B.B. .BBB.','BBBB. BB..B B...B B..BB BBBB.','.BBBB .B..B BB..B .B..B .BBBB','BBB.. B.BBB B.B.B B.BBB BBB..','BBB.. B.B.. BBBBB ..B.B ..BBB','BBBBB B.B.B BBB.B B...B BBBBB','BBBBB B..B. B..B. BBBB. B....']
print("slot0 set == slot1 set:", set(seq)==set(slot1_cycle))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def get_slot(fr, r0, r1, c0base, i):
    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c0=c0base+7*i
    g=[['B' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+7)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
